verdict: Paid Instagram is punching above its weight; the weak link is intake follow-through and organic presence.
diagnosis: Instagram lead campaign is producing 335 leads at roughly $28 each this period — well below the legal industry norm.

signals.headline: 335 leads at $28 each
signals.detail: The August Re-Launch campaign delivered leads at a cost most consumer law firms would consider a bargain.

signals.headline: 1,910 landing page views this period
signals.detail: Roughly 32% of clicks reached the landing page. Healthy load-through, but only 18% of those viewers converted.

signals.headline: 65 new five-star reviews added
signals.detail: Reputation is a genuine asset. Total review count now 770 with a perfect 5.0 average.

signals.headline: 176 call clicks from Google profile
signals.detail: Local presence is driving direct phone intent. Zero direction requests suggests clients hire remotely, not in person.

signals.headline: Only 33 Instagram followers
signals.detail: Paid reach is strong but the organic account is essentially dormant. No follower base to retarget or nurture.
